message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the normalized primary-product inventory during the last 24 hours.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only, combined, normalized, and deduplicated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-17 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-18 23:40 UTC (2026-10-18 05:10 IST through 2026-10-19 05:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

Fresh CVE and advisory records were checked against the named products and obvious aliases. Candidates were excluded when they were stale, matched only an adjacent product or plugin, or lacked credible evidence tying the affected software to the monitored inventory. Source coverage included vendor advisories, the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), CVE/NVD-indexed records, [CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), and established security-vulnerability databases.

### Possible matches needing review

**Ubuntu / upstream Linux kernel CVE batch**

- **Issue:** A large batch of upstream Linux-kernel CVEs was published on October 18, including CVE-2026-98862 (audit use-after-free), CVE-2026-98858 (io_uring use-after-free), and CVE-2026-98810 (mac80211 out-of-bounds read).
- **Severity:** Not stated in the fresh records reviewed.
- **Why it may matter:** Ubuntu is monitored and uses the Linux kernel, but the scan did not find Canonical status pages confirming which Ubuntu releases or kernel packages are affected by these new identifiers. This is therefore a product-family lead, not a confirmed Ubuntu finding.
- **Sources:** [Rapid7 recent CVE index](https://www.rapid7.com/db/?page=2), [Ubuntu CVE tracker](https://ubuntu.com/security/cves)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated in the scan window. Recent official MongoDB security-bearing server releases dated October 13 were outside the window and excluded. Sources: [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 9.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/), and [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories).

### Review priority

No immediate action is indicated from a confirmed in-scope finding. A routine Ubuntu kernel review is advisable once Canonical publishes package and release applicability for the newly assigned upstream Linux CVEs.
